full_name: Maggie Blackhawk | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Law Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor New York University School of Law
bio: Maggie Blackhawk (Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Ojibwe) is a professor of law at New York University and an award-winning interdisciplinary scholar and teacher of constitutional law, federal Indian law, and legislation.
